answer: Resist sybils with multi-domain anchor attestation: an identity earns weight only after independent anchors, separate institutions using different checks, each attest it, like a lantern lit only when several keepers agree it burns. One anchor stamp alone is velvet-soft, worthless by itself; weight needs a quorum across domains sharing no staff, data, or incentives. An attacker minting ten thousand sybils must corrupt several independent domains per fake, turning cheap forgery into a multiplied conspiracy, while an honest agent collects its anchors once and keeps its oasis of standing.
